opportunities.name: Hypercharge proc ambush
opportunities.objective: Use the three maximum-speed cannon attacks for a focused item window.
opportunities.mechanic: Hyper Charge grants three attacks at maximum speed with 0.7-1.1 AD damage depending on rank. Blade supplies current-health physical on-hit, Kraken rewards the third attack, and Essence Reaver gives a single post-cast Spellblade plus mana. Transforming into Cannon makes the first attack shred defenses, then Hammer Q/E can finish with mixed damage.
opportunities.requiredState: Need high W rank, a clear three-shot target and transformation timing before firing.
opportunities.failure: Low-rank W reduces attack damage; target exits range or defensive items absorb the short burst.
opportunities.test: Measure each of the three shots and the defense shred before adding Hammer follow-up.
opportunities.rejectedAssumption: Three Hyper Charge attacks do not mean three Spellblade procs without new ready cast windows.

opportunities.name: Lightning field hybrid hammer
opportunities.objective: Test the AP field while retaining useful hammer AD interactions.
opportunities.mechanic: Hammer Lightning Field has 1 AP magic damage over four seconds; Hammer transform adds a magic attack term and Thundering Blow deals percent-health magic plus an AD expression. Gunblade gives mixed offense, Dusk and Dawn rewards a transformation-weaved real attack, and Abyssal serves the field's magic damage. Hammer Q remains physical AD, giving the route an explicit tradeoff.
opportunities.requiredState: Need prolonged Hammer contact and reliable form cycling without being kited.
opportunities.failure: Field's small area and weak ranged Q threaten lane control; E knockback ends your own contact.
opportunities.test: Compare four-second Hammer contact damage against separate ranged poke and standard physical itemization.
opportunities.rejectedAssumption: Hammer E's AD ratio still deals magic; lethality does not improve that component.

ruledOut.reason: Cannon Q's empowered expression is 1.3 AD statFormula=2 times 1.4, without an AP term.

unknowns: Several form tooltips are wrappers; exact transform shred percent display and Spellblade form ordering need live checks.

Run three trials at matched level, ranks, gold and target defenses. Repeat against a moving opponent with a fixed incoming damage pattern. Record damage packets, missed actions, resource cost and survival separately.
Keep souls, health/mana, form, item/rune stacks, transformations and game time finite and explicitly recorded. No free full ramp or infinite scaling.
failureConditions: Low-rank W reduces attack damage; target exits range or defensive items absorb the short burst.

Confidence: plausible. Source-compatible reasoning is not in-game validation or proof of novelty/optimality.
buyOrder: Candidate six slots: Blade of The Ruined King, Essence Reaver, Kraken Slayer, Infinity Edge, Lord Dominik's Regards, Berserker's Greaves. Compare two-item checkpoints before the final six-slot test; this list is not a lane shopping order.
Keep role-appropriate starters, boots and support quest/vision obligations. If the full candidate assumes farmed income, compare it separately from support income.
coverageNotes: Only Cassiopeia Q/E and Sett W have numerical adapters. Even there, these other objectives and item/rune interactions may fall outside the model.
Proc inheritance, crit, pet hits and conditional helpers remain uncertain until observed. No completed mathematical maximum is claimed.
